response.sql: WITH pr AS (SELECT p.arcregistry AS project_id, p.fundflux AS funding_source, AVG(s.boxx) * 1.0 / NULLIF(AVG(s.boxz), 0) AS ratio FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.arcregistry, p.fundflux), fa AS (SELECT pr.*, AVG(ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY funding_source) AS avg_ratio FROM pr) SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, ratio - avg_ratio AS margin FROM fa ORDER BY margin DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
